import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# Select the most recent year's data (2015) for analysis
year = '2015 [YR2015]'

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df[year].values
school_primary_enrollment = school_primary_df[year].values
school_secondary_enrollment = school_secondary_df[year].values
economic_output_exports = exports_df[year].values
economic_output_gni = gni_df[year].values

# Calculate correlation coefficients
correlation_education_primary = pearsonr(education_expenditure, school_primary_enrollment)
correlation_education_secondary = pearsonr(education_expenditure, school_secondary_enrollment)
correlation_primary_exports = pearsonr(school_primary_enrollment, economic_output_exports)
correlation_primary_gni = pearsonr(school_primary_enrollment, economic_output_gni)
correlation_secondary_exports = pearsonr(school_secondary_enrollment, economic_output_exports)
correlation_secondary_gni = pearsonr(school_secondary_enrollment, economic_output_gni)

# Perform linear regression for education expenditure on economic output
X_education = education_expenditure.reshape(-1, 1)
y_gni = economic_output_gni
model_education_gni = LinearRegression().fit(X_education, y_gni)
coefficient_education_gni = model_education_gni.coef_[0]

# Perform linear regression for school enrollment on economic output
X_primary = school_primary_enrollment.reshape(-1, 1)
model_primary_gni = LinearRegression().fit(X_primary, y_gni)
coefficient_primary_gni = model_primary_gni.coef_[0]

X_secondary = school_secondary_enrollment.reshape(-1, 1)
model_secondary_gni = LinearRegression().fit(X_secondary, y_gni)
coefficient_secondary_gni = model_secondary_gni.coef_[0]
